Scope: collector and local roads; potable water, sewage, storm drainage, irrigation, TSE, medium-voltage, street lighting and telecom networks; a sewage pump station and storm drainage ponds; boundary fence, guard room and utility buildings.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 16-Nov-2026 data date the construction works (131,328 budgeted man-hours, the basis used in earlier weeks) are 26.9% complete against 42.3% planned (SPI 0.64). This week added 1.19%, from the fence, utility buildings and roads; the networks did not move. On the dashboard's wider basis, which also counts engineering, procurement and testing man-hours, progress is 27.1% against 53.1% planned (SPI 0.51).

The schedule update finishes the project five months late. The P6 update with data date 16-Nov-2026 schedules project completion on 03-Aug-2027, 151 days after the contract completion date of 05-Mar-2027 and 7 days later than last week's update, with −122 days of total float. The weekly report's key dates now give the same forecast completion. Finishing on time needs about 4.9% physical progress a week for the 15 weeks left; this week added 1.19%.

Buildings and earthworksFence and guard room foundations are almost complete and walls are at 75%. Utility building grade beams and slabs are complete, but their columns are at 24%. Embankment fill is at 41% and road subgrade at 14%; the storm pond riprap is at 45%.

Data notes

  • This-week values compare the 16-Nov-2026 weekly report (WPR-39) with the 09-Nov-2026 report (WPR-38) in the W07 folder.
  • The Milestones sheet states contract week 45, used as the report week; its "of" figure shows −6575, a broken formula. Whole weeks from site handover to the data date give 44.
  • As last week, this report keeps the construction basis (131,328 man-hours): 26.9% against 42.3%. The dashboard divides by 218,880 man-hours, including engineering, procurement and testing, and gives 27.1% against 53.1% (SPI 0.51).
  • The workbook is in a new layout this week: the Progress sheet and the dashboard group the networks into three lines, the Manpower sheet is weekly, and the risk and issue logs moved to a separate file.
  • Planned man-hours to date for potable water and irrigation (9,562) exceed the line's budget (8,248). The fence's planned man-hours to date fell from 23,264 to 21,103.
  • The weekly physical columns and the dashboard's "earned this week" still repeat 708 planned and 445 earned man-hours (fence only). This week's gain (1,559 man-hours, +1.19%) was taken from the change in cumulative earned man-hours; it comes with no change in the Major Quantities sheet.
  • The chart data's November value (59,271 man-hours, 27.1%) adds engineering and procurement to months that count construction only (27,338 in October), so it shows a one-month gain of 31,933 man-hours.
  • The Major Quantities and Procurement sheets are unchanged since 26-Oct-2026, and the supply tracking file is the same file as in the last two weeks. That file uses project ID DHRT-02-01 and names a different project manager ("م/ نواف").
  • The Milestones sheet has no rows for the street lighting and telecom networks; their weekly report forecasts are from the milestone slide in the PowerPoint. The sheet gives mobilisation a change of 7 days, the slide 1 day.
  • The Conclusion sheet still gives 260,000 m³ of earthworks against 428,344 m³ in the Major Quantities sheet, storm pipe lengths of 4,838 m against 4,672 m in the Procurement sheet, and milestone dates in early 2027 that differ from the P6 update.
  • The Manpower sheet's weekly actuals do not match last week's monthly figures (for example 162 manual workers in the week of 06-Sep against 35 for September), and for this week it gives 93 on site while the dashboard gives 246. The dashboard also shows manual and staff head counts under each other's headings.
  • Cumulative safe man-hours rose from 128,730 to 143,130 (+14,400), while this week's hours are 4,800; 14,400 is the month-to-date figure.
  • The QC checklist still uses project DHRT-02-001 and the date 14-Apr-2026 although its score changed from 0.84 to 0.92; the HSE inspection still covers 27-Jan to 03-Feb-2026.
  • The invoice log shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000, an EAC of 20,900,000 and potential changes of 200,000, which do not match this contract or the dashboard (0).
  • The risk register uses the ID Rsk-06 twice: for the advance payment risk and for a second copy of the BOQ savings opportunity, scored 8 instead of 4. The issue log closes the advance payment issue, but the P6 update and the risk register show it as open.
  • The Schedule sheet still counts 1,271 activities with the same statistics as in earlier weeks; the uploaded P6 file has 1,065.
  • One photo carries a stamp of 10-Oct-2026 and may predate this week.
  • The Financial Progress sheet reports cost-based progress; it is not used in this report.
